notablePrerequisites: Zimone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing it.
When Umbral Collar Zealot dies, Yedora triggers, returning Umbral Collar Zealot from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Umbral Collar Zealot enters the battlefield as a Forest land, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning the creature face-up.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1, doing nothing.
Repeat.
